coordinator_decision.context: Close the committed no-run V13 review after three fresh, role-separated, exact-commit inspections.
rationale: Theory and accounting issued scoped GO, but red team issued REVISE; unanimous authorization for launch-plan design was not obtained and execution remains unauthorized.

All nine V13 source hashes match the reviewed commit, and the completed operation vector independently reproduces as 480 prime candidates, 112 draws, 336 curve hashes, 218 point enumerations, and 4218 predicate hashes.

Direct calls to the public writer can escape the development root through lexical dot components because containment normalization is not enforced inside the writer.
The forced direct-write branch can report accepted after observing a nonregular or wrong-size final inode.
The hard-link-success control does not exercise os.link, and the stated independent receipt validation reuses the production publication_status implementation.
The immutable V12 provenance record names the wrong red-team filename even though its recorded hash matches the correctly committed artifact.
The exact mathematical protocol, zero-run budget, and ECDLP claim limitations remain unchanged.
limitations: No generated V13 density row, canonical matrix, runner, launch plan, or run authorization was created.
Historical V1 development artifacts and transient legacy controls are not V13 canonical evidence.
Structural counters remain distinct from CPU, RSS, parser and allocator memory, disk, I/O, cache traffic, and memory bandwidth.
No relation generation, rank, target descent, preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, deployment, or ECDLP result is in scope.

Retain maximum_runs=0 and request fresh exact-commit review before launch-plan design.
